'''Conversationalist''' is a [[social skill]] used by dwarves while making friends. Dwarves that are particularly good at this tend to make friends easily and will often rise to [[mayor|mayoral]] positions. 

To train this skill, let dwarves idle and chatter amongst themselves. Dwarves who [[Personality trait#GREGARIOUSNESS|prefer to be alone]] and [[Personality trait#BASHFUL|bashful]] dwarves will never gain [[experience]] in this skill. Additionally, dwarves who [[Personality trait#FRIENDSHIP|are put off by friendship]] and dwarves who [[Personality trait#LEISURE_TIME|are offended by leisure time]] may be unable to gain experience in conversing.
